subject.title: feat: serve signed publisher feed projections

question: Should the existing catalog endpoint switch unconditionally to signed DSSE responses once this stack lands, or must the signed contract use a staged/versioned rollout that preserves current clients until the trust root is deployed?
rationale: This choice defines a public client trust boundary and production secret rollout; source review cannot determine the intended compatibility policy or guarantee coordinated ClawHub and OpenClaw deployment ordering.

options.title: Stage The Signed Cutover
options.body: Keep current behavior available until the prerequisites, production signing secret, bundled OpenClaw trust root, and upgrade proof are all ready, then perform the canonical switch.

options.title: Add A Versioned Signed Route
options.body: Preserve the existing route and expose the signed publisher and catalog projections through a new versioned contract until consumers migrate.

options.title: Accept A Coordinated Breaking Cutover
options.body: Intentionally switch the existing endpoint in one coordinated release and own temporary failures for clients or deployments that miss the key rollout.

recommendation.title: Stage The Signed Cutover
recommendation.body: Keep current behavior available until the prerequisites, production signing secret, bundled OpenClaw trust root, and upgrade proof are all ready, then perform the canonical switch.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged hosted-feed work established the stored-publication and trust contract now being changed.
